name: The Westin Resort Nusa Dua, Bali
positioning: A beachfront family and wellness resort on Nusa Dua Beach in Bali, with a private beach section, lagoon-style pools, a Heavenly Spa and a resident Wellness Ambassador
best_for: Families who want a kids club, waterslide and beach on site
Wellness travelers who want yoga, meditation and spa time by the sea

facts.text: The resort is on the white sands of Nusa Dua Beach.
The resort is next to the Bali International Convention Centre.
Rooms have marble vanities and deep soaking tubs.
Beachfront cabanas directly in front of the resort have uninterrupted sea views.
The spa uses local ingredients such as seaweed and clay.
The wellness programs include Reiki, daily yoga, meditation and pranayama breathing.
Wellness options also include reformer pilates, an ice bath and beach workouts.
Children have the Westin Family Kids Club and a waterslide.
The resort has two lighted tennis courts.
Guests can join a Balinese dance lesson, watch fruit carving or visit the hotel temple.

highlights.text: The resort has a private section of Nusa Dua beach.
Each Ocean View Suite is named for one of six Balinese regions and has its own design.
Terrace rooms have a private outdoor area with lounge chairs and direct access to the lagoon-style pools.
The Heavenly Spa has his and hers thermal facilities and a Shiatsu room.
Wellness Ambassador Dr. Jitendra Pokhriyal leads the resort's wellness programs.

considerations.text: The resort sits next to the Bali International Convention Centre, so it also serves business and event travelers.
WhataHotel notes the large property may mean walking distances between facilities.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the luxury positioning.
